seed_ledger.name: Polaris Forge 1 power station
seed_ledger.reason: EXISTING_ROW: Polaris Forge 1 is Applied Digital's Ellendale, North Dakota campus. Industrial Info says it tracks 4.2 billion dollars of Applied Digital data center and power projects that would benefit from WBI's Bakken East pipeline, and earlier press described a planned southern Bakken East lateral from Jamestown to Ellendale for an Applied Digital gas plant, which is roster row P8327 (parent P8096). Tag lead for P8327 and P8096; the Ellendale-specific wording was only seen in search snippets, not in the fetched page text, so researcher should confirm. Searches run: 5. Sources checked: Industrial Info article on the 500 million dollar Bakken East guarantee (Applied Digital tie); PGJ Online Nov 2025 on Bakken East for power and data center growth (general data center demand, no Ellendale text found); North Dakota Monitor on Bakken East (no Ellendale text found); DCD and Industrial Info on the B&W gas power deal for Applied Digital (site not named); MDU electric service agreement release (electric only).

evidence.note: Applied Digital data center and power projects tied to Bakken East
Bakken East serves power and data center demand
B&W gas plants for Applied Digital, site not stated

seed_ledger.name: Polaris Forge 2 power station
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Polaris Forge 2 is the Harwood, North Dakota campus (280 MW peak), served with electricity by Cass County Electric through Minnkota. Minnkota's 400 MW gas plant in Harmony Township near Mapleton sits at the end of an existing WBI pipeline, but Minnkota's CEO says it is not being built for a data center, and it is not due until 2031 or 2032. No source names a dedicated gas pipe for Harwood; P0367 at 1.5 km stays unconfirmed. Searches run: 4. Sources checked: Valley News Live Oct 2026 (Minnkota plant, site chosen near WBI line); States Newsroom (Cass County Electric serves Harwood, plant not for a separate data center); earlier run's EIA, FERC and PSC checks not repeated.

evidence.note: Minnkota plant near WBI pipeline end
Cass County Electric serves Harwood; plant not for data center
